provider: CAL FIRE / Fire and Resource Assessment Program (FRAP)
api_version: CAL FIRE FRAP firep25_1, April 2026 (public ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0)

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only exact official ArcGIS service item 14c312c213fb4be8b97a37238a871255, unfiltered 'California_Fire_Perimeters__all_' layer 0. A future metadata-only review may consider f=pjson on the fixed path; there is NO authorized feature query, geometry download, pagination, user-provided URL/headers, arbitrary where clause, export or external dataset acquisition under this contract.

response_contract.format: Official ArcGIS Feature Layer metadata description and field schema only; not a feature collection or fire polygon.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: FRAP firep25_1 historical wildfire perimeters are multiagency final-mapped wildfire polygons spanning decades to 2025. Their geometry is not fire intensity, building-level burn, independent survey of all fires or a full exposed-building denominator. The archive includes version-dependent collection thresholds, missing events, duplicate and generalized polygons and sometimes unburned areas inside final perimeters; they must not be equated with DINS observed building damage.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Do not automate, query or crawl the ArcGIS service until exact API terms, release-specific rights and a separately fixed metadata-only recipe have been reviewed.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Public service is mutable and historical shapes/attributes are corrected in later releases. Source edition firep25_1 must be frozen separately from the current API's present bytes, along with UTC, request identity, byte count and SHA-256. May 2026 source description says firep25_1 is the current edition.

rights_and_policy.notes: State public portal identifies 'Creative Commons Attribution' and no public-use restrictions. Specific data-file attribution, exact version and API service-automation terms have not passed source-specific rights review; the contract thus cannot authorize sample download or public redistribution of derived geometry.
